states.meaning: payload and validation receipt immutable for bound dependencies
typed finding closure and CAS preconditions recorded; no mutation yet
new revision accepted; historical bytes retained
candidate failed and cannot be a merge input

thaw_triggers.proof: changed authority path intersects declared dependency set
old dependency hash is present in artifact dependency set
SEMANTIC_IMPACT_CLOSURE_V1 includes artifact ID/path and bounded closure
validator emits causal path from failing invariant to artifact nodes

forbidden_triggers: same error without new dependency proof
cas: Thaw request must supply stable artifact_id, expected artifact_revision, expected payload_sha256, expected validation_receipt_sha256 and closure_sha256. Mismatch rejects as stale.
version_increment: A changed payload creates artifact_revision + 1. Same bytes reuse the existing revision and do not count as progress.
invalidation: Propagate only over the reverse dependency graph. Source artifacts in the closure thaw; deterministic projections/merge/global receipts become stale and recompute. Unrelated frozen artifacts retain hashes and receipts.
downstream_recomputation: Stages 3-6 recompute locally wherever possible. Model stages 1-2 rerun only for explicitly thawed units.
oscillation_guard: A superseded revision is never overwritten. Returning to a prior payload hash is no progress unless authority/dependency hash changed; repeated issue signature plus unchanged closure and state delta terminates.
